svg.title: ParticleLab observation-conditioned proposals: every fixed seed
svg.desc: Mean RMSE versus Kalman across all 16 seeds for bootstrap and conditional proposals. Two 12-step development examples at observation standard deviations .5 and .01. Panel scales differ. The conditional method has worse average variance RMSE in the inherited .5-noise example, despite a similar mean RMSE.

svg.text: ParticleLab | condition the proposal, audit the approximation
All 16 seeds, 12 inherited observations, N=32, a=.9, process std .4, prior mean 0/std 2, ESS fraction .5.
Mean RMSE against scalar Kalman. Lower is closer for this metric only. Panel scales differ.
Seed. Purple dashed: bootstrap; teal: conditional.
Seed. Purple dashed: bootstrap; teal: conditional.
Inherited case variance RMSE: bootstrap .035944; conditional .037895. No uniform metric improvement.
Both methods still use finite particles and ancestral histories. Same seed does not mean identical paired random noise.
Fixed development examples, all runs retained. No held-out, equal-time, calibration or global optimality claim.
